text:
Control Panel for Twitter

 

 Control Panel for Twitter is a browser extension for desktop and mobile browsers, which gives you more control over Twitter and adds missing features and UI improvements 

 [!IMPORTANT]
 This is the support repository for Control Panel for Twitter - for installation links, screenshots, information about the extension, and FAQs, please visit the Control Panel for Twitter website.

Check the latest updates and availability for your browser on the releases page.

Follow @ControlPanelFT on Twitter for extension news and other announcements.

 Support

To report a bug create a new Issue here on GitHub.

Please include:

- The version of Control Panel for Twitter you're using
- The browser and operating system you're using it on
- Relevant URLs and screenshots if applicable

If you don't have a GitHub account, you can use the Browser Extension Feedback & Support form on our website instead, or email extensions@soitis.dev.
